description: Text and JSON compare. Use when a task needs to know exactly what changed between two versions of a text, document, config file or JSON payload: line, word or character changes with a unified patch, or a JSON Pointer list of structural changes. Inputs are capped at 1,000,000 characters a side and 1,500,000 combined; lines and words mode handle that whole range, while chars mode on a heavily rewritten document falls back to block-level changes (coarse: true in the response) rather than taking longer. Cost: 1 credit per call.

a.description: The first version. Up to 1,000,000 characters.

b.description: The second version. a and b together are capped at 1,500,000 characters.

context_lines.description: Lines of context in the unified patch, 0-20.

ignore_whitespace.description: Treat runs of whitespace as equal.

name: text_diff
